description: Semi-synthetic pediatric EHR benchmark: stock Synthea background + post-hoc SIGNAL_A/B and S0/S1/S2 labels.

strata.name: infant
strata.note: Synthea targetAge is integer-cast; 0-0 yields age in [0, 1) years at the reference date.

strata.name: early_childhood
strata.note: age_flag max is exclusive after integer cast, so 1-6 yields target ages 1..5 (1.0 to <6.0 years).

signal_time_rule_detail: Independently for A and B, if the patient is assigned the signal, sample one existing event timestamp uniformly from timestamps strictly before index_date. If none exist, place the signal at the midpoint of [birthdate, index_date). At most one A and one B per patient.
notes: Stock Synthea modules only. Custom peds_obesity/t2d/osa/asthma modules are NOT loaded.
Does not write to synthea/output or data/synthea (prior 0-25 custom-module cohort is left untouched).
All experiment artifacts live under synthea/sep1-exp/; generated CSVs/parquets are under synthea/sep1-exp/output/.
Index date is the fixed Synthea reference date for every living patient.
Intercepts for S0/S1/S2 are calibrated at build time to the target prevalence; event/age/interaction coefficients are never searched.
